title: registry.json schema — solver applicability
description: Solver-applicability registry gating the WU-8 run matrix: which (solver,problem,thread,build) cells are legal to schedule. Built against INSTALLED package versions (WU-10), not aspirational ones. Field semantics: contract.md §4.

solvers.description: Keyed by solver id (matches runs.parquet 'solver' column and weights_ref filename component).

arm.description: Language arm this solver entry runs under. leafblower has one entry per arm (both point at the same C++ core).

families.description: Objective families this solver optimizes; drives Dolan-Moré profile stratification (DESIGN.md §7) and which agreement metrics apply (§6: vector-correlation only for strictly-convex families).

bounds.description: Bound-constraint support. A solver whose 'bounds' excludes 'bounded' is never scheduled against a bounded problem spec.

K_max.description: Largest margin count K validated for this solver; null = unbounded K. Caps 2-marginal-only OT competitors (e.g. ott-jax/POT) to K<=2 problems.

builds.description: Applicable build variants. Competitor entries are always ['na']; leafblower entries carry ['portable','native'] (or a subset if a variant is not yet built for this solver).

applicable_problems.description: Problem spec ids (spec/*.json 'id' field) this solver is validated + eligible to run against. Empty array is legal (solver installed but not yet wired to any problem) but such a solver contributes zero rows to runs.parquet.
